description: This file contains utility functions for handling expanded weights in PyTorch, including batch dimension checks, argument standardization, forward pass helpers, and tensor summation utilities related to ExpandedWeight objects.

classes.name: ExpandedWeight
classes.description: A class representing expanded weights used in custom weight handling in PyTorch.

methods.name: is_batch_first
methods.description: Determines if the batch dimension is first based on a list of ExpandedWeight arguments.

methods.name: standard_kwargs
methods.description: Separates positional arguments and keyword arguments from expanded args, standardizing kwargs.

methods.name: forward_helper
methods.description: Executes a forward pass with expanded weights, handling argument unexpanding and detaching outputs.

methods.name: _check_and_unexpand_args
methods.description: Validates and converts expanded args and kwargs to their original weights or tensors.

methods.name: maybe_scale_by_batch_size
methods.description: Scales gradient samples by batch size if loss reduction is 'mean'.

methods.name: set_grad_sample_if_exists
methods.description: Sets the gradient sample attribute for a weight or tensor if applicable.

methods.name: unpack_expanded_weight_or_tensor
methods.description: Returns the original weight or tensor from an ExpandedWeight or tensor.

methods.name: sum_over_all_but_batch_and_last_n
methods.description: Sums a tensor over all dimensions except the batch and last n dimensions.
